_comment: GLOBAL SITE INFO — edit this file once and it updates every page. Three values still need your confirmation, marked CONFIRM below.
name: Narrow Digital Marketing
_url_note: Your live domain. No trailing slash. Builds canonical tags, sitemap.xml and robots.txt.
_email_note: Appears in the nav menu, the footer, the CTA band and the contact page. When you set up Cloudflare Email Routing, change this one line to hello@narrowdigital.tech and forward it here — nothing else needs touching.
_phone_note: phoneHref is what the tap-to-call link uses: digits only, with the +1 country code.
serviceArea: Yucaipa, Banning and the Inland Empire
_serviceArea_note: Widen or narrow this as you take on work. Keep it truthful — it is a local search signal.
_hours_note: CONFIRM — change to whatever is actually true for you, or delete the Hours row on the contact page.
_social_note: Empty on purpose — an empty footer beats a link that goes nowhere. When you have profiles, add rows like { "label": "Instagram", "url": "https://instagram.com/..." }
